import time

import polars as pl
import vl_convert as vlc
from great_tables import GT
from IPython.display import publish_display_data
from qte.bootstrap import BootstrapConfig

QS = [0.25, 0.50, 0.75]

# Kept deliberately small so the page builds quickly while the documentation is being iterated on.
BOOTSTRAP = BootstrapConfig(n_iter=50, seed=42, n_workers=4)


def show_chart(chart) -> None:
    """Render an Altair chart as inline SVG.

    Publishing the HTML directly keeps this a single cell output; returning an ``HTML`` object
    would add an empty ``text/plain`` output as well, and Quarto would split the figure into
    sub-figures.
    """
    publish_display_data({"text/html": vlc.vegalite_to_svg(chart.to_dict())})


class timer:
    """Report how long a block took."""

    def __init__(self, label: str) -> None:
        self.label = label

    def __enter__(self) -> "timer":
        self._start = time.perf_counter()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.label}] {time.perf_counter() - self._start:.2f}s")
